title: Deluxe Estate Room
subtitle: A calm garden-facing room for slow mornings, private conversations, and restful nights in Coorg.
description: Warm timber details, soft linen, and a private sit-out make this room feel intimate without feeling small. It is designed for couples and solo travellers who want quiet, comfort, and a clear connection to the estate landscape.
highlights: Compact luxury layout with calm, natural textures

content.heading: A private corner of the estate
content.text: The Deluxe Estate Room keeps the mood soft and personal. Every detail is meant to slow the day down, from the reading corner to the balcony that looks into layers of green.

content.heading: Designed for easy rest
content.text: Expect a plush bed, refined bath amenities, gentle lighting, and enough space to unpack, unwind, and feel settled from the first evening.

title: Premium Coorg Villa
subtitle: A more spacious villa with quiet privacy, valley air, and a lounge made for unhurried evenings.
description: The Premium Coorg Villa is shaped for guests who want more room to breathe. A generous lounge, private deck, and immersive views create a polished retreat for longer stays and special escapes.
highlights: Separate lounge for reading and conversation
Valley-facing deck with filtered morning light

content.heading: More room, more privacy
content.text: This villa gives the stay a slower rhythm. It is generous without feeling formal, balancing premium finishes with the quiet warmth of a Coorg estate home.

content.heading: For evenings that linger
content.text: The lounge and deck make space for coffee, conversations, and the kind of silence that becomes the best part of a holiday.

title: Family Plantation Suite
subtitle: A generous suite for families who want shared comfort, private sleep, and effortless estate living.
description: Built for families and small groups, this suite gives everyone space to gather and space to retreat. It pairs a larger layout with calm materials, estate views, and thoughtful conveniences.

content.heading: Made for being together
content.text: The Family Plantation Suite is relaxed, practical, and premium. It gives families a polished base for estate walks, long meals, and quiet evenings.

content.heading: Comfort without compromise
content.text: The larger footprint keeps the suite calm even when everyone is moving through the day at a different pace.
